card.name: Noun or adjective before a following clause
card.fires_on: A noun or adjective that comes just before a verb phrase or connecting word, such as 'these antibiotics', 'the highway', 'patient or caregiver'. It also fires on 'leisure' in 'leisurely'. The setting is mixed, in label text and general web text.

modes.description: A noun that is the subject of a clause and is about to be followed by its verb.

modes.description: The word caregiver after 'patient or' in administration directions.
modes.example: Instruct the patient or<< caregiver>> not to use the BENLYSTA auto
